alternatives.name: Rippling public REST API docs
alternatives.summary: Official API surface exposes HR, reports, software deployments, and draft hires but not the full IT device lifecycle UI.

gaps: No public endpoints found for laptop ordering, shipping, return box retrieval, device lock, or wipe.
Generated REST-beta CLI had no curated IT workflow namespace before this publish pass.
patterns: Public API supports draft hires, software deployments, reports, report-runs, and identity/access-adjacent resources.
Dry-run-first workflow commands are safer for mutating enterprise admin surfaces.

novel_features.name: IT public API coverage map
novel_features.description: Summarizes public-API-backed Rippling IT capabilities and explicitly documents unsupported device ordering, retrieval, lock, and wipe gaps.

novel_features.name: New-hire IT onboarding plan
novel_features.description: Builds a safe dry-run-first IT onboarding plan that can create draft hires and software deployments through documented public endpoints.

novel_features.name: Device software deployment workflow
novel_features.description: Wraps software deployment list/create operations with IT-friendly flags for role and device-group deployment workflows.

novel_features.name: Hardware inventory report schema
novel_features.description: Exposes documented Reports API hardware inventory fields so agents can build device inventory reports without guessing field names.
